claim.claim-text: 1. A method for wireless communication at a user equipment, UE, comprising:
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the UE determines a number of the flexible symbols that are allocated for communication with the base station based on the indication.

3. The method of claim 1, wherein the designated downlink symbols (240) precede the flexible symbols (245), and the designated uplink symbols (260) follow the flexible symbols (245) during an allocation to the UE for a first time period (265) within a frame.

4. The method of claim 3, wherein a length of the first time period is determined based at least in part on one or more of following factors: an amount of data to be transmitted, a quality of service, QoS, associated with the data, a delay requirement of the data, a number of other UEs, or channel conditions.
5. The method of any of claims 1 to 4, wherein the configuration is received via physical downlink control channel, PDCCH, signaling.
6. The method of any of claims 1 to 4, wherein the configuration is received via radio resource control, RRC, signaling.
7. The method of any of claims 1 to 6, wherein the base station comprises an SCell.
8. An apparatus for wireless communication at a user equipment, UE, comprising:
9. The apparatus of claim 8, wherein the UE determines a number of the flexible symbols that are allocated for communication with the base station based on the indication.

10. The apparatus of claim 8, wherein: the designated downlink symbols (240) precede the flexible symbols (245), and the designated uplink symbols (260) follow the flexible symbols (245) during an allocation to the UE for a first time period (265) within a frame.

11. The apparatus of claim 10, wherein a length of the first time period is determined based at least in part on one or more of following factors: an amount of data to be transmitted, a quality of service, QoS, associated with the data, a delay requirement of the data, a number of other UEs, or channel conditions.
12. The apparatus of any of claims 8 to 11, wherein the configuration is received via physical downlink control channel, PDCCH, signaling.
13. The method of any of claims 8 to 11, wherein the configuration is received via radio resource control, RRC, signaling.
14. The method of any of claims 8 to 13, wherein the base station comprises an SCell.

15. A computer program comprising instructions which when the instructions are executed on at least one processor of an apparatus for wireless communication at a UE cause said UE to carry out the method of any of claim 1 to 7.
